title: feat: serve the media agent from weaver.pollinations.ai
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- `polli.pollinations.ai` is meant for exposing the Polli Discord bot as a model (per @Itachi-1824 in dev-polli); the media agent was squatting on it
- Rebinds to `weaver.myceli.ai` / `weaver.pollinations.ai` and points `apps.json` at the `weaver` subdomain
- Worker `name` deliberately stays `polli-agent`, so the running container is reused rather than orphaned
- Merging deploys: the `apps/**` push trigger on `main` runs `Apps / Deploy changed apps`

Follow-up after merge: repoint the `voodoohop/polli` community endpoint at the new host and drop the stale `polli.*` custom domains.

gist.headline: The media weaver moves in
gist.blurb: The media agent has unpacked its pixels at weaver.pollinations.ai, leaving polli.pollinations.ai free for its Discord-bot destiny. Same hardworking worker, tidier place in the garden.
gist.summary: Rebound the Polli media agent from polli.pollinations.ai to weaver.pollinations.ai (also weaver.myceli.ai) and updated the app registry while retaining the polli-agent Worker name so its running container is reused.
gist.impact: Media-agent users and community endpoints can now use the dedicated weaver host, while polli.pollinations.ai is available to expose the Polli Discord bot as a model.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy garden workshop where Polli helps a friendly media-weaving machine move glowing image, audio, and video threads into a new little cottage labeled WEAVER. The unchanged polli-agent Worker is represented by the same familiar humming CRT-powered loom, while code-vines and flowers show that the service is settling into its dedicated home.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden workshop where the main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny weaver's cap and guides glowing media threads into a retro CRT loom beside a cottage with simple pixel-font text: “WEAVER.” Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, code-plants and flowers, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
